description: Data-layer refactor to the two-level config format. Split the config model into TenantConfig (user-scoped: server_url, x_api_key, encryption_public_key, encryption_private_key, access_token, access_token_expiry) and a slimmed ProfileConfig (project-scoped: name, project_id, project_name, tenant_name pointer, output_format). Make ConfigParser parse/serialize both [tenant <name>] and [profile <name>]/[default] sections, make ProfileResolver merge a profile's referenced tenant, and make TokenManager cache/persist the access token keyed by TENANT (the token is user-scoped and shared across the tenant's projects). Update the cli.py token-resolution call site. Update and extend the property/unit tests. This feature is foundational: FEAT-002 depends on it.
steps: In src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/config_parser.py: add a `TenantConfig` dataclass with fields name, server_url (default 'ica.illumina.com'), x_api_key, encryption_public_key, encryption_private_key, access_token, access_token_expiry (all Optional[str] except name/server_url). Slim `ProfileConfig` down to name, project_id, project_name, tenant_name, output_format (default 'table'); remove server_url, x_api_key, token_tid, encryption_public_key, encryption_private_key, access_token, access_token_expiry from it.

In config_parser.py: split `_KNOWN_KEYS` into tenant keys and profile keys. Change `parse(content)` to return a tuple (tenants: Dict[str, TenantConfig], profiles: Dict[str, ProfileConfig]). Keep the existing line-by-line logic (comment handling for # and ;, blank-line skip, whitespace trim, duplicate-key-last-wins, '=' split on first occurrence, malformed-line ConfigParseError with line numbers, key-before-section error). Route sections whose header is 'tenant <name>' into the tenants map (build TenantConfig) and 'default'/'profile <name>' into the profiles map (build ProfileConfig). Keep output_format validation against VALID_OUTPUT_FORMATS for profile sections.

In config_parser.py `_parse_section_header`: add a branch for headers starting with 'tenant ' that extracts and regex-validates the tenant name with PROFILE_NAME_REGEX (empty-name and invalid-name ConfigParseError like the profile branch), and have it signal the section kind to the caller (e.g. return a (kind, name) tuple or a sentinel-prefixed name) so parse() can route correctly. Keep the existing 'default' and 'profile <name>' branches and the unrecognized-header error.

In config_parser.py: change `serialize(profiles)` to `serialize(tenants, profiles)` emitting tenant sections first (alphabetical, header '[tenant <name>]', only tenant keys), then '[default]' if present, then named profiles alphabetically (header '[profile <name>]', only profile keys). Only write non-None fields. Update `parse_file(path)` to return the (tenants, profiles) tuple and `write_file(path, tenants, profiles)` to accept both maps; keep os.chmod(path, 0o600) and parent-dir creation.

In src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/profile_resolver.py: add `tenant_name: Optional[str]` to the ResolvedConfig dataclass. In `resolve()`, parse into (tenants, profiles); keep the existing profile-selection precedence (_determine_profile_name, _has_explicit_profile_source) and the no-profiles / profile-not-found errors against the profiles map. After selecting the profile, look up profile.tenant_name in tenants; if the profile has a tenant_name that is not present, print an error to stderr naming the profile, the missing tenant, and the sorted available tenant names, then sys.exit(1). Build ResolvedConfig with server_url/api_key/cached_access_token/encryption_private_key/encryption_public_key from the tenant and project_id/project_name/output_format from the profile; set tenant_name. base_url = https://<server_url>/ica/rest. Keep _apply_env_overrides (ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN, ICAV2_PROJECT_ID, ICAV2_BASE_URL) unchanged.

In src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/token_manager.py: rename the TokenManager constructor parameter and attribute `profile_name` to `tenant_name` and update every `self.profile_name` reference and error/log string accordingly. In `_persist_token`, parse into (tenants, profiles), locate the tenant named self.tenant_name (return early if absent), set its access_token (encrypted if keys available) and access_token_expiry, and call parser.write_file(self.config_path, tenants, profiles). Leave _is_token_fresh (>3600s via TOKEN_REFRESH_THRESHOLD), _get_token_expiry, _generate_token, _resolve_secret, _encrypt_if_keys_available, and validate_env_token unchanged.

In src/icav2_cli_plugins/utils/cli.py `_resolve_profile_and_token`: construct TokenManager with tenant_name=config.tenant_name instead of profile_name=config.profile_name; derive private_key_path/public_key_path from config.encryption_private_key/encryption_public_key as today. Leave the env-token validation path and project-id fallback resolution intact.

Update tests in tests/test_config_parser_properties.py: adapt the hypothesis strategies (profile_config_strategy no longer has server_url/x_api_key/token_tid etc.) and all parse/serialize calls to the (tenants, profiles) tuple API. Add a TenantConfig strategy and a tenants-dict strategy. Keep the '# Feature: profile-based-config, Property N: ...' tags; extend Property 1 round-trip to cover tenants + profiles together. Add a new test asserting a parsed [tenant <name>] section lands in the tenants map with its six fields.

Update tests in tests/test_profile_resolver_properties.py to the tuple API and the tenant-merge behavior. Add a unit test 'profile references missing tenant' asserting SystemExit and that stderr names the profile, the missing tenant, and the available tenants. Keep env-precedence Properties 4 and 5 passing (server_url/api_key now sourced from the referenced tenant).

Update tests in tests/test_token_manager.py and tests/test_token_manager_properties.py: construct TokenManager(tenant_name=...), and update _persist_token tests to assert the token+expiry are written onto the [tenant <name>] section. Add a test proving the token is cached per tenant and shared across two profiles that reference the same tenant (generate once, second resolution reuses the fresh cached token). Continue mocking requests.post for token generation (no live network).
acceptance_criteria: config_parser.py exposes TenantConfig and a slimmed ProfileConfig; parse/parse_file return (tenants, profiles) and serialize/write_file accept (tenants, profiles).
A config containing one [tenant t] and two [profile a]/[profile b] sections round-trips through serialize->parse unchanged, tenants serialized before profiles.
Resolving a profile whose tenant_name has no matching [tenant] section exits non-zero with a stderr message naming the profile, the missing tenant, and the available tenants.
TokenManager persists access_token/access_token_expiry onto the referenced [tenant] section and is keyed by tenant_name; two profiles sharing a tenant share one cached token.

Running `uv run pytest tests/test_config_parser_properties.py tests/test_profile_resolver_properties.py tests/test_token_manager.py tests/test_token_manager_properties.py -p no:orcabus_pipeline_test_utils` passes all tests.

findings:
Data layer refactored to two-level config. config_parser.py now exposes TenantConfig (name, server_url default 'ica.illumina.com', x_api_key, encryption_public_key, encryption_private_key, access_token, access_token_expiry) and a slimmed ProfileConfig (name, project_id, project_name, tenant_name, output_format default 'table'). ConfigParser.parse/parse_file return a (tenants, profiles) TUPLE; serialize/write_file take (tenants, profiles) and emit tenant sections first (alphabetical, '[tenant ]'), then [default], then '[profile ]' alphabetically. _parse_section_header returns a (kind, name) tuple where kind in {'tenant','profile'} ('default' maps to ('profile','default')); tenant headers validate names with PROFILE_NAME_REGEX. write_file still chmod 0600 and creates parent dirs. ProfileResolver.ResolvedConfig gained a 'tenant_name' field. resolve() unpacks (tenants, profiles); profile selection precedence is unchanged. After selecting a profile, if profile.tenant_name is set but absent from tenants, it prints to stderr 'Profile '

' references tenant '' which is not configured. Available tenants: ' and sys.exit(1). server_url/api_key/cached_access_token/encryption keys now come from the referenced tenant; project_id/project_name/output_format from the profile. A profile with tenant_name=None resolves api_key=None and server_url default. Env overrides (ICAV2_ACCESS_TOKEN/PROJECT_ID/BASE_URL) unchanged. TokenManager: constructor param/attribute renamed profile_name -> tenant_name (still FIRST positional arg, so TokenManager(name, path) callers are unaffected); all error/log strings now say 'tenant'. _persist_token writes access_token/access_token_expiry onto the [tenant ] section (returns early if the tenant is absent) and calls write_file(path, tenants, profiles). Token is user-scoped: two profiles sharing a tenant share one cached token. _is_token_fresh/_generate_token/etc. unchanged. cli.py _resolve_profile_and_token now builds TokenManager(tenant_name=config.tenant_name, ...). It still references config.profile_name in the 'no API key' error message (profile_name remains a valid ResolvedConfig field). FEAT-002 MUST DO: the configure commands still use the OLD single-map API and flat ProfileConfig and are the ONLY remaining failures under tests/. Update src/icav2_cli_plugins/subcommands/configure/configure_set.py (parse_file/write_file now return/accept (tenants, profiles); it constructs ProfileConfig(server_url=..., x_api_key=...) which no longer accepts those kwargs -> must create/update a TenantConfig for server_url/x_api_key/encryption keys/token and a ProfileConfig for project_id/project_name/tenant_name/output_format; this is the 'set-tenant' + 'set-profile' split) and configure_list.py (unpack the tuple). Correspondingly update tests/test_configure_set.py and tests/test_configure_commands.py (they build ProfileConfig with server_url/x_api_key and call write_file(path, profiles)).
